item.subject: science
item.stem:
The diagram shows a bar magnet resting on a sheet sprinkled with iron filings. Mohan taps the sheet gently so the filings can move.

Where does the magnet attract the iron filings most strongly?

options.A: Everywhere equally along the whole bar.
options.C: Most strongly in the middle and least at the ends.
